describe: Stats, items, conditions, effects, a choice limit, ranked endings and a share line on top of `choice_story`. Normally written by the story-graph compiler (authoring/expander/story-graph.mjs) from a `story-graph/1`, not by hand. The game supplies the source lists as state from content: `sg_src_labels` and `sg_src_next` (3 per scene, like choice_story's), and per choice (index s*3+c) `sg_need` (a condition: atoms `<var index>>=<n>` or `<var index><=<n>` joined by '&', alternatives by '|'; '' = always open), `sg_do` (effects: space-separated `<var index>:<delta>` or `<var index>:=<value>`), `sg_route` (`<condition>~<scene>` alternatives joined by ';', checked after the choice's effects, first match wins), `sg_note` (a toast); per scene `sg_enter` (effects on arrival), `sg_place` (a small label over the text), `sg_end_title`, `sg_end_id`, `sg_end_tag` ('Ending 2 of 5'), `sg_end_points` (digits) and `sg_share` (a share template with {choices}, {limit}, {ending} and {<var id>}); per variable `sg_var` (ids), `sg_label`, `sg_kind` ('stat', 'item' or 'flag'), `sg_init`, `sg_lo`, `sg_hi` and `sg_weight` (score points per unit, digits). Only open choices are shown, packed into the first buttons. With `limit` > 0, the limit-th choice that doesn't reach an ending goes to scene `limit_to`. The run is won or lost `curtain_ms` after the ending appears (good endings win), so the ending can be read. Score: the ending's points, plus `bonus` per unused choice on a good ending, plus each variable times its weight; it changes only on `ending_reached`. Provides `ending` (the ending's id, '' before) and `choices_used` (the group-play story result, HARNESS_V2 social.result kind ending), `sg_vals` (list<int>), `sg_used`, `sg_end` (scene index of the ending, -1 before), `sg_share_line` and `sg_path` (choice indices taken, dot-separated). Pictures (optional, made at build time by authoring/expander/image-art.mjs): with the game's `still` sprite (one frame per key scene) it draws a scene picture at the top, 320 × 164 centred on (180, `still_y`); `stills` names each scene's frame ('.'-separated, one per scene, -1 for none). With a `portrait` sprite (one frame per main character) it draws that character's portrait in a ring at (`portrait_x`, `portrait_y`); `cast_at` names each scene's character the same way. Move the text and buttons down (choice_story text_y 292, button_y 418; place_y 262, card_y 424) to make room.

still.describe: Scene pictures: one frame per key scene, 320 × 164 (wide), a moment of the story in the game's style. Which scene shows which frame is the `stills` param.

portrait.describe: Character portraits: one frame per main character, a square head-and-shoulders bust on a clear background. Which scene shows whom is the `cast_at` param.

sg_atom.body: if atom == '' then true else if len(split(atom, '>=')) == 2 then get_or(vs, sg_int(sg_part(atom, '>=', 0)), 0) >= sg_int(sg_part(atom, '>=', 1)) else if len(split(atom, '<=')) == 2 then get_or(vs, sg_int(sg_part(atom, '<=', 0)), 0) <= sg_int(sg_part(atom, '<=', 1)) else false

sg_holds.body: trim(cond) == '' or any(split(cond, '|'), alt => all(split(alt, '&'), a => sg_atom(trim(a), vs)))

sg_apply.body: let toks = filter(split(fx, ' '), t => trim(t) != '') in map(range(len(vs)), i => clamp(fold(filter(toks, t => sg_part(t, ':', 0) == str(i)), get_or(vs, i, 0), (acc, t) => let v = sg_part(t, ':', 1) in if starts_with(v, '=') then sg_int(substr(v, 1, 12)) else acc + sg_int(v)), sg_int(get_or(sg_lo, i, '0')), sg_int(get_or(sg_hi, i, '1'))))

sg_open.body: get_or(sg_src_labels, s * 3 + c, '') != '' and sg_holds(get_or(sg_need, s * 3 + c, ''), sg_vals)

sg_target.body: let nv = sg_apply(sg_vals, get_or(sg_do, s * 3 + c, '')) in let picked = fold(reverse(filter(split(get_or(sg_route, s * 3 + c, ''), ';'), r => trim(r) != '')), get_or(sg_src_next, s * 3 + c, ''), (acc, r) => if sg_holds(sg_part(r, '~', 0), nv) then sg_part(r, '~', 1) else acc) in if @limit > 0 and @limit_to >= 0 and sg_used + 1 >= @limit and get_or(story_ends, sg_int(picked), '') == '' then str(@limit_to) else picked

sg_labels_now.body: let opn = sg_shown(scene) in map(range(len(sg_src_labels)), i => if i / 3 != scene then '' else let o = get_or(opn, i % 3, -1) in if o < 0 then '' else get_or(sg_src_labels, scene * 3 + o, ''))

sg_next_now.body: let opn = sg_shown(scene) in map(range(len(sg_src_next)), i => if i / 3 != scene then '' else let o = get_or(opn, i % 3, -1) in if o < 0 then '' else sg_target(scene, o))

sg_score.body: if sg_end < 0 then 0 else sg_int(get_or(sg_end_points, sg_end, '0')) + (if sg_good_end() and @limit > 0 then max(0, @limit - sg_used) * @bonus else 0) + sum(map(range(len(sg_vals)), i => get_or(sg_vals, i, 0) * sg_int(get_or(sg_weight, i, '0'))))

sg_share_text.body: fold(range(len(sg_var)), replace(replace(replace(get_or(sg_share, sg_end, ''), '{choices}', str(sg_used)), '{limit}', str(@limit)), '{ending}', get_or(sg_end_title, sg_end, '')), (acc, i) => replace(acc, '{' + get_or(sg_var, i, '') + '}', str(get_or(sg_vals, i, 0))))

sg_stats_text.body: join(map(filter(range(len(sg_vals)), i => get_or(sg_kind, i, '') == 'stat'), i => get_or(sg_label, i, '') + ' ' + str(get_or(sg_vals, i, 0))), '  ·  ')

sg_bag_text.body: let held = filter(range(len(sg_vals)), i => get_or(sg_kind, i, '') == 'item' and get_or(sg_vals, i, 0) > 0) in if len(held) == 0 then '' else 'Bag: ' + join(map(held, i => get_or(sg_label, i, '')), ', ')

then.to: if sg_path == '' then str(picked) else sg_path + '.' + str(picked)

node.text: = if sg_end >= 0 then str(sg_used) + ' of ' + str(@limit) else 'Choice ' + str(min(sg_used + 1, @limit)) + ' of ' + str(@limit)
